messages:
maria_g: quick heads up — during a staging smoke test I saw svcacc:analytics-sa able to call KMS:decrypt for org-b project keys. seems like a workspace->key assertion mismatch.

alex_t: can you paste exact request id + log lines? need to triage impact and reproduce steps.

jordan_r: fwiw I pushed the rbac-refactor PR (GH #4123) yesterday that changed project->workspace aliasing; might be related.

sec-bot: ALERT: kms_decrypt_unexpected — actor=svcacc:analytics-sa key=projects/org-b/keys/ingest timestamp=1732504444 request_id=xyz123

samir: if confirmed, quick mitigation is to remove kms:decrypt from that service account in staging and patch the role-binding transformer to enforce workspace-scoped assertions.

iris: quick audit query I ran: `SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE action = 'KMS.Decrypt' AND actor = 'svcacc:analytics-sa' AND timestamp > 1732500000` — showed 3 hits, all against org-b keys.

alex_t: ok, can someone run `rbacctl get-bindings --svcacc analytics-sa --format json` and capture the policy_id on those allow decisions? Also grab pod envs that set WORKSPACE_ALIAS.

maria_g: logs snippet: ```json
{"time":1732504444,"actor":"svcacc:analytics-sa","key":"projects/org-b/keys/ingest","action":"KMS.Decrypt","result":"allow","policy_id":"rbac-v2-2026"}
```

samir: rolling a patch to deny cross-org key assertions now (small validation in the transformer) + will add a smoke test to CI. applying to staging first.

oncall: temporary ACL change applied: removed kms:decrypt from analytics-sa in staging at 1732504700, watching for breakage. will report back.

jordan_r: PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4123 — adding stricter assertion validation. I'll add unit + integration tests that exercise org/project alias paths.

iris: please file a vuln-triage ticket with blast radius and reproduce steps. I'll start the incident doc and postmortem template after we confirm scope.

alex_t: plan: 1) stop-gap ACL removal (done), 2) patch transformer (in flight), 3) add KMS gating e2e smoke, 4) run full audit across prod keys, 5) postmortem + mitigation backlog. owner: @maria_g for postmortem.

maria_g: thanks — I'll create the incident ticket, add affected keys list and timeline, and add follow-up tasks to the security board. will update here when CI smoke passes. :thumbsup:
